Seat_1.description: 1st bushing seat  (the hole the FIRST bushing goes into)

Seat_2.label: 2nd hole
Seat_2.description: 2nd bushing seat  (the hole the SECOND bushing goes into)

provenance.feasibility_note: POS-FEAS-01 is a synthetic CAD observability study (3.38 % seat-region change at 35 deg elevation). It is not a measurement of real-camera accuracy. No accuracy figure should be quoted for this feature until a labelled real-camera test set has been measured.
provenance.scope_note: Seat anchors are image coordinates and are valid only while the assembly orientation on the fixture and the camera pose are unchanged. Re-run this tool after any camera or fixture change. Pose normalisation is a documented extension.
provenance.acceptance_radius_note: Seat centres are 30.1 px apart. The radius is 40% of that (12.1 px), strictly below half the separation so the two acceptance regions cannot overlap. The previous value of 18.0 px exceeded half the separation (15.1 px), so a bushing in either hole fell inside both regions.
